there were 250 000 light-commercial vehicles (LCVs) and 1000 electric trucks.

The prickly pear cactus

When it was brought to Australia, it spread rapidly, covering millions of
hectares of farmland.
Farmers unsuccessfully tried several
methods of controlling the cactus.

South America was introduced.
The larvae of this moth ate the cacti

population.
